decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed dormer windows by reason of their size, siting and design, do not sit comfortably within the elevations proposed and would therefore fail to preserve or enhance the character of the Conservation Area, moreover the side dormer specifically would result in an unacceptable loss of privacy to the occupiers of No.8 Church Road.

Condition : 2 - The proposed garden store by reason of its siting, size and design would be a prominent feature in Caroline Close breaking the existing fence line that is established and remove existing landscaping with the potential to damage further landscape features within the close.
Condition : 3 - The proposed walkway and single storey rear extension by reason of their height, rearward depth and location, would have an adverse affect upon the outlook of No.6 Church Road.

Condition : 4 - The proposed driveway by reason of its siting and a design would be a prominent feature in the street scene, breaking the continuous frontage within Church Street and removing planting. This would fail to preserve of enhance the character of the Conservation Area.

Condition : 5 - The proposed access by reason of its relationship to the existing wall and structures on site would result in the failure to achieve an adequate visibility splay, which would have a detrimental affect upon highway and pedestrian safety. This is contrary to Policies T.5.3 (Vehicle Crossovers and hardstandings and T.4.4 (Road Safety) of the London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003.
description: Erection of a roof extension, single storey rear extension, detached single storey garden room to rear with covered walkway, and vehicular hardstanding to front dwellinghouse.
